sourceReference: User-confirmed 2026-10-08: MB6015 ready means reset complete/stationary/start allowed; MB2009 rising edge then Ready 1->0->1 then clear; MB2007 rising edge then clear after first actual complete motion and bilateral clearance; MB2008 and heartbeat loss stop in place, no automatic return; startup XYZ=0. See specs/021-commissioning-console/contracts/start-and-completion.md SC-021-PLC-R2. R3 user-confirmed: before reset PC MB2006=1 and MB2008=0 must be freshly read back; applies with or without prior soft stop; reset never first asserts soft stop. See SC-021-PLC-R3. R4 user-confirmed 2026-10-08: PLC system reset fully restores workpiece, releases gripper and restores flip mechanism; old run closes only after fresh reset/safety/clearance checks and durable cancellation. R5 user-confirmed 2026-10-09 supersedes the earlier Ready falling/rising requirement: after PC sends MB2009, PLC completes reset and sets MB6015=1; PC freshly reads 1 after the request write returns, clears MB2009, then performs existing safety/position/recovery checks. Observing Ready=0 is not required; old pending reset requests are not automatically cleared or replayed. See SC-021-PLC-R5.
